from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

img = Image.open('radiograph.jpg')

draw = ImageDraw.Draw(vis)
# Adjust box to crop coordinates

# Also let's draw on full image or a wider crop
vis_wide = img.crop((1400, 700, 1800, 1100)).convert('RGB')
draw_wide = ImageDraw.Draw(vis_wide)
draw_wide.rectangle([box[0]-1400, box[1]-700, box[2]-1400, box[3]-700], outline='red', width=2)
vis_wide.save('box_verification_wide.png')
print('Saved verification images')
